title: 2026-10-24 英文軌：詞塊與跟讀
description: 昨日回顧、短文、5 個詞塊（weigh on stocks 等，例句附中文並停頓跟讀）、1 個句型與一句輸出練習。美式發音。
queue: 這裡是今天的英文練習。開車請專心，你只需要用耳朵聽，再開口跟著念。
第一段，昨天的回顧。我先說中文，停四秒，請你說出英文，然後我再念答案。
第二段，今天的短文。先聽一次，再聽中文意思，最後慢速再聽一次。

This week, oil climbed above one hundred sixteen dollars a barrel, stoking inflation fears and weighing on stocks. In education, a study of nearly one thousand math teachers found that high expectations are not enough; students also need specific feedback. And in medicine, an AI system beat generalist doctors in a simulation, but we still need to see whether the results hold up in the real world.
中文意思。這個星期，油價漲到每桶一百一十六美元以上，引發通膨擔憂，也拖累了股市。在教育領域，一項針對近一千位數學老師的研究發現，只有高期待是不夠的，學生還需要具體的回饋。在醫療領域，一套 AI 系統在模擬測試中勝過一般醫師，但我們還需要看看，結果在真實世界是否站得住腳。

This week, oil climbed above one hundred sixteen dollars a barrel, stoking inflation fears and weighing on stocks. In education, a study of nearly one thousand math teachers found that high expectations are not enough; students also need specific feedback. And in medicine, an AI system beat generalist doctors in a simulation, but we still need to see whether the results hold up in the real world.
第三段，今天的五個詞塊。每一個，我會念詞塊，說中文，念例句，說例句的意思，再慢速念一次，然後停三秒，請你跟著念。
Rising oil prices weighed on stocks on Friday.
意思是，油價上漲，週五拖累了股市。
Rising oil prices weighed on stocks on Friday.
The oil rally stoked inflation fears across the market.
意思是，油價大漲，在整個市場引發了通膨擔憂。
The oil rally stoked inflation fears across the market.
Good coaches give specific feedback instead of vague praise.
意思是，好教練給的是具體回饋，而不是空泛的稱讚。
Good coaches give specific feedback instead of vague praise.
She set high expectations and showed students how to reach them.
意思是，她設定了高期待，也示範學生如何達到。
She set high expectations and showed students how to reach them.
hold up in the real world
意思是，在真實世界站得住腳。
We still need to see whether the results hold up in the real world.
意思是，我們還需要看看，這些結果在真實世界是否站得住腳。
We still need to see whether the results hold up in the real world.
The key is not A, but B
意思是，重點不是 A，而是 B。
The key is not how hard you push, but how clearly you guide.
意思是，重點不是你推得多用力，而是你引導得多清楚。
The key is not how hard you push, but how clearly you guide.
第五段，輪到你。請用這個句型，在心裡說一句關於你上一堂課的英文。停八秒。
The key is not how many drills we do, but how clearly I explain them.
意思是，重點不是我們做幾種練習，而是我說明得多清楚。
今天的五個詞塊，會在明天、三天後、七天後，再出現一次。
